nodes.label: Nomisma local research workspace
nodes.rationale: The browser and native apps share a loopback Python backend, server-side credentials and SQLite research state. Monitoring requires explicit Start. Persistent source-aware alerts, immutable plans and validated backups retain provenance; version 1.2.4 documents verified stocks-only screening.

nodes.label: Independent persisted research schedules
nodes.rationale: Candidate discovery and daily screening have separate New York weekday schedules, same-day startup catch-up, persisted success dates and 15-minute retries. The process/computer must remain running. Discovery never changes monitor symbols or starts streaming; separate scan processes do not share the in-process lock.

nodes.label: Mocked provider tests and isolated browser verification
nodes.rationale: The unittest suite covers calculations, timing, transport, storage, scheduling and HTTP protections. Provider mocks do not establish actual credentials or entitlement. Browser checks use a temporary database/profile and save desktop/mobile screenshots.

hyperedges.label: Application distribution separated from credentials and research state
